title: Farm view: every state
sub: Screenshots of the live farm view, so this page stays fast. The live frame beside this board is the real thing: click around in it.
sections: The farm: the bar, 3D bottom left, Select bottom right
At a room: ‹ goes up, the name switches rooms
Click the name: the rooms at this level
3D opened: the camera tools and Edit layout
A running task: the legend filters the pens
A finished task: outcomes and performance
Compare: pens below the batch tinted
Pigs: pick a kind, only those pens keep their colour
A group pen: its pigs, ticked one by one
Climate: set point and trends; the controller on the wall
Ammonia: its trend; the sensor marked on the farm
Feed line: one device, its line to the pens it serves
Camera: the feed in the panel, its view on the floor
Moving floor (demo): Auto, the lane it runs
Heat lamps: pens picked in Plan, the bar is the control
Select: Plan, actions waiting for a pick
Pens picked: the count, the actions, Cancel
Pigs ticked in a pen: the same bar
At 960 wide: ‹ › step through the actions
